paper_title: Improved limits on the coupling of ultralight bosonic dark matter to photons from optical atomic clock comparisons
coupling_convention: d_e dimensionless (computed from 95% CL amplitude limits via paper Eq. 8; NOT read from a table)
notes: Paper constrains scalar coupling d_e of ultralight DM to photons via oscillation of alpha, measured with Yb+ E3/E2 and E3/Sr optical clock comparisons over mass range ~1e-24 to 1e-17 eV. No numerical table of d_e vs mass is provided; the exclusion curve is only shown in Fig. 4. Data points here were COMPUTED from Eq. 8 using the stated amplitude constraints (~2e-17 for E3/E2, ~3x better for E3/Sr above 1e-20 eV), k_alpha=6.95 (E3/E2) and 6.01 (E3/Sr), and rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3. In the flat-amplitude region d_e scales linearly with mass; below ~1/T (few 1e-21 eV) a 1/omega^2 amplitude scaling makes limits weaker. Values are approximate. Limits include factor-3 stochastic-fluctuation rescaling. 95% CL. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 8))
